column1: # Competitors added from SWOT_ANALYSIS.md section K (2026-10-24), the final protocol's conditions (bench/k_bench.sh): 64 cores (galaxy: taskset -c 0-63; a2: numactl --interleave=all), warmed page cache, three rounds, output to /dev/null (Columba: a scratch SAM, deleted).

# DRAGMAP 1.3.0 (bioconda; aarch64 build on galaxy, x86-64 on a2), hash table of the same GRCh38 primary assembly as every index; Columba 2.0 (edcc7ce, built with -fsigned-char) best mode, >= 96 % identity, on 2 M reads / pairs; mm2-fast (14fe36c, AVX-512, minimap2 2.24 based) against minimap2 2.24 and 2.31 -ax sr, one .mmi index.

# Reads: HG002 NovaSeq X, 20,001,073 reads (single-end, R1) or pairs; mode *-2M: the first 2,000,000. Context (final_{galaxy,a2}.tsv, slow_galaxy.tsv): CERTA interval mode 15.4 / 37.8 s galaxy, 18.2 / 38.0 s a2 (single-end / paired, 20 M); --full-cert 5.58 / 12.46 s at 2 M on galaxy.
